title: This AI Agent Runs on Your Computer
description:
Stop paying for cloud AI agents. This one runs entirely on your computer.
It's called AutoClaw. Z.AI just dropped a one-click app that lets anyone run OpenClaw locally on their own machine. No API keys, no complicated setup — download, open, and go.
It comes with 50+ pre-built skills covering content creation, office automation, code generation, and more. No manual configuration required — start automating tasks immediately after installation.
Here's what makes it different. Your data never leaves your machine. No subscriptions to cloud servers. No one reading your prompts. Connect any model you want, or use their GLM-5-Turbo, built specifically for tool calling and multi-step tasks.
Go to my Instagram (link in the channel description) and comment "CLAW" under the post — I'll send you the link with all the details.
#ai #aitools #aiagents #automation #openclaw
